## Objective and bounded outcome

Reconstruct H6 known-truth media transformations and row/geo-specific `true_beta_gc` independently
of fitted transform parameters and pooled channel coefficients, then certify the held-out Delta-mu
and contribution recovery used by future holdout evidence. This task is evidence-only and must not
change production Ridge/Bayesian behavior, replay, optimizer/economics, Delta-mu authority, or
public/package contracts.

Use existing H6 generators, transform-truth fields, intervention semantics, aggregation metrics,
and deterministic research entry points only. Report the truth construction, intervention, fixed
nuisance state, aggregation estimand, fitted-versus-truth quantities, absolute recovery error, and
limitations. Do not add a new estimator, DGP framework, causal method, or validation framework.
